tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
4-Port Single Power G-EPON Mini OLT – High-Performance, Scalable & Reliable Fiber Network Solution

High-Speed G-EPON OLT for FTTX & ISP Networks

The 4-Port Single Power G-EPON Mini OLT is a compact, high-performance optical line terminal, designed to deliver ultra-fast and reliable fiber connectivity for ISPs, enterprise networks, smart cities, and surveillance systems. Featuring 4 SFP PON ports, 2 Gigabit SFP uplink ports, and 2 Gigabit RJ45 uplink ports, this OLT supports up to 256 ONUs with a 1:64 splitter ratio and a transmission distance of up to 20km.


Engineered for maximum compatibility, it works with all ONUs available in the market, making it a versatile and future-proof solution for FTTX deployments. With WEB-based management, a 1U rack-mountable design, and an integrated cooling fan, it ensures efficient operation, easy scalability, and long-term reliability.


Key Features 

  • High-Performance 4-PON G-EPON OLT – Supports up to 256 ONUs with a 1:64 splitter ratio.
  • Extended Fiber Reach – Supports transmission distances up to 20km for seamless long-range connectivity.
  • Universal ONU Compatibility – Works with all ONU brands, ensuring maximum flexibility.
  • Multiple Uplink Options – 2 x 1000M SFP ports & 2 x 1000M RJ45 uplink ports for high-speed data transmission.
  • WEB-Based Management – Easily configure, monitor, and manage the network remotely.
  • Efficient 1U Rack-Mountable Design – Built-in cooling fan for heat dissipation & long-term stability.
  • Ideal for FTTX & ISP Deployments – Delivers ultra-fast broadband, VoIP, IPTV, and surveillance services.


Technical Highlights

Port Configuration

  • 4 x SFP PON Ports – Supports Gigabit EPON fiber network deployment.
  • 2 x 1000M SFP Uplink Ports – Ensures high-speed fiber uplink connectivity.
  • 2 x 1000M RJ45 Uplink Ports – Supports flexible Gigabit Ethernet networking.
  • WEB-Based Management – Allows easy configuration, monitoring, and troubleshooting.


Network Performance & Capacity

  • Max Splitter Ratio – 1:64 (Supports up to 256 ONUs).
  • Long-Distance Transmission – Supports fiber connections up to 20km.
  • Multi-Service Support – Ideal for IPTV, VoIP, broadband, and surveillance applications.
  • QoS & VLAN Support – Optimized network traffic management & segmentation.
  • Future-Proof Design – Compatible with all ONU devices in the market.


Ideal Applications

  • FTTX & FTTH Deployments – High-speed fiber connectivity for homes & businesses.
  • ISP & Telecom Networks – Scalable and reliable fiber networking for service providers.
  • Enterprise & Data Centers – Robust fiber-optic infrastructure for high-performance networking.
  • Smart Cities & Surveillance – Supports high-definition video monitoring & security systems.
  • Rural & Urban Broadband Expansion – Ideal for towns, villages, and growing communities.


Why Choose This 4-Port G-EPON Mini OLT?

  • Ultra-Fast Fiber Networking – Provides seamless, high-speed data transmission.
  • Scalable & Future-Proof – Supports up to 256 ONUs with a 20km transmission range.
  • Universal ONU Compatibility – Works with all ONU brands for flexible deployment.
  • Advanced Management & Monitoring – WEB-based control for simplified network operations.
  • Efficient & Reliable Design – 1U rack-mountable with built-in cooling fan for long-lasting stability.
